**Release:** v1.3.0 (2026-08-02) added per-client rate limiting, according to `CHANGELOG.md`. Each client is identified by IP address and the limit is set by `rate_limit.requests_per_minute`.

**Default limit:** 120 requests per minute (with a burst of 20), per `config/defaults.yaml`.
